base: (A) Personal property including its income received and accounted for, plus gross proceeds of real property sold; (B) separately, value of real property not sold and of non-probate property includable for Ohio estate tax as of 12/31/2012 (except joint and survivorship) (R.C. 2113.35).

schedules.text: 4% of the first $100,000; 3% above $100,000 up to $400,000; 2% above $400,000 (R.C. 2113.35(A)). Full compensation for ordinary services (R.C. 2113.35(C)).

schedules.who: Fee on real property not sold (R.C. 2113.35(B))
schedules.text: 1% on the value of real property not sold, and 1% on non-probate property includable for Ohio estate tax as of December 31, 2012, except joint and survivorship property (R.C. 2113.35(B)).
schedules.capNote: Applies to a separate base from schedule (A).
